# The group stage keeps its order and its cancellation rules under
# js/wasm: the order and cancel fixtures build with logos for the wasm
# target and print the same lines under the tree's node wrapper.

[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.lgo order/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.lgo cancel/main.lgo

cd order
logos build -o order.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec order.wasm
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.out
cd ../cancel
logos build -o cancel.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec cancel.wasm
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.out
cd ..

-- order/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageorder

go 1.27

-- cancel/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagecancel

go 1.27
